title: OPERATOR CARD: ONE FRAME, 40PX X, READABLE CONFIRM
why: The critic scored the operator card 3 of 5 on 62 and 63: the lime row wore a fill plus a ring (double frame), the armed confirm was red on maroon with low contrast and no lime focus bar, and the 48px X was heavier than the title and 4px off its centre. Restyle only, same text.
now: The operator card has one frame on the lime row, a lighter 40px X, and the armed confirm is readable.
